verdict.rationale: The evidence shows MemoryBench, a harness for running your own benchmarks against Supermemory, Mem0 and Zep, plus a marketing claim of "State-of-the-art memory". Neither is a set of published benchmark results. No LongMemEval, LoCoMo or other published scores backing recall-accuracy claims appear anywhere in the pack. A self-run benchmarking tool is adjacent to this story and earns no credit for it.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published memory-quality benchmark results (e.g. LongMemEval, LoCoMo) backing the product's recall-accuracy claims
